items.title: Dragalia Lost - Event Stories (2019)
items.description:
Dragalia Lost footage for archival purposes.

This archive is missing high quality footage for the Mega Man Chaos Protocol event.

Archive.org will not allow accept the Valentine's Confections story names in the metadata.
